newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich airport cargo traffic up 0.9pct Jan-Nov.
newsitem.headline: Zurich airport cargo traffic up 0.9pct Jan-Nov.

text.p: Global cargo traffic handled at Zurich airport between January and November 1996 was up 0.9 percent on the same period 1995.
Cargo traffic handled by Swiss airlines at Zurich airport declined by 2.7 percent on 1995 levels to 222,688 tonnes while foreign carriers volume was up by 0.7 percent to 71,912 tonnes.
Trucked airfreight grew by 9.1 percent on January-November 1995, to 112,613 tonnes, the airport authority said.
Postal traffic totalled 15,304 tonnes, up 0.6 percent on the same period in 1995. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
